# BalatroEditor

> A free browser-based editor for Balatro save files (.jkr). Edit your profile stats, manage joker collection unlock states, and export modified saves — no installation required.

## What It Does

BalatroEditor lets Balatro players:
- Import and export `.jkr` save files (Lua-serialized, deflate-compressed)
- View and edit profile stats (win streaks, challenge progress, card stats)
- Manage joker/tarot/planet/spectral collection (unlock, lock, discover cards)
- Browse a visual card catalog with search and category filters
- Works entirely client-side — no server, no data leaves your browser

## Key Features

- **Profile Editor**: View and modify save file statistics
- **Collection Manager**: Toggle unlock/discovered/alerted states for all collectible cards
- **JKR Converter**: Full Lua-to-JSON parser with deflate compression/decompression
- **Multi-language**: English and Spanish interface
- **Image Catalog**: Visual card browser with CDN-loaded artwork and local cache
- **Zero Backend**: 100% client-side SPA, open `index.html` in any browser

## Tech Stack

- Vanilla JavaScript SPA (no framework, no build step)
- Pako 2.1.0 for deflate/inflate (JKR compression)
- Font Awesome 7.1 for icons
- Inter font for typography
